74691323.was: Carte réduite des débouquemens de St. Domingue dressée pour le service des vaisseaux du roy. Par ordre de M. le duc de Choiseul, colonel général des suisses et grisons, ministre de la guerre et de la marine. M.DCC.LXV
74691323.title: Reduced chart of the channels of Saint-Domingue, drawn for the service of the King's ships. By order of the Duc de Choiseul, Colonel General of the Swiss and Grisons regiments, Minister of War and of the Navy. 1765
74691323.note: Two faults. Debouquemens is an 18th-century naval term for the channels by which a ship works its way out of the Antilles; the translator half-copied it into deboutmen, a word in no language. And M.DCC.LXV is the year 1765, which came back as Mr.DCC.LXV -- the M read as an abbreviation for a man. Carte reduite is the period's term for a small-scale chart. Suisses et grisons is right as Swiss and Grisons: these are the regiments in French service that Choiseul was colonel general of, not the canton, so this is the one place the word should not become Graubunden.

14002124.was: Planʺ stolichnago goroda Sanktpeterburga cʺ izobrazhenīemʺ znatni︠e︡ĭshikhʺ onago prospektovʺ
14002124.title: Plan of the capital city of St Petersburg, with depictions of its most notable prospects
14002124.note: Pre-reform Russian in Library-of-Congress romanization (Planŭ stolichnago goroda Sanktpeterburga sŭ izobrazheniemŭ znatneishikhŭ onago prospektovŭ), left untranslated because language detection found nothing. Stolichnago goroda is 'capital city'; znatneishikh is 'most notable'; prospektov is ambiguous in 18th-century usage (views or avenues) and is rendered 'prospects'. Sanktpeterburg stays a name.

2002624054.was: Le grand teatre de la guerre en Italie
2002624054.title: The great theatre of the war in Italy
2002624054.note: 'Teatre' is the old spelling of théâtre, here the period sense of a theatre of war; the translator read it as 'star' (étoile). Likely a map series title, so the sense is the operational area.

2004632070.was: Plan topografico del Valle de Centa
2004632070.title: Topographical Plan of the Valle de Centa
2004632070.note: Language was misdetected, but the text is a plain Spanish/Italian-style title and the earlier rendering was essentially right. Valle de Centa is a place name and must stay as written; do not anglicise it to 'Centa Valley'.

2011590182.was: Travajo personal que en la inspesion de esta corta obra tubo el Ro. Pe. F. Juan Miguel Menchero como Visitador General de la Nueva Mexico y lo dedica a el Exmo. Sr. Dn. Juan Franco. Guemes y Orcasitas Virrei, Gobernador y Capitan General de Nueva Espana para que su ex proteja su major incremento de estas misiones
2011590182.title: Personal work which the Reverend Father Fray Juan Miguel Menchero did in inspecting this short work, as Visitor General of New Mexico, and which he dedicates to the Most Excellent Lord Don Juan Francisco Güemes y Horcasitas, Viceroy, Governor and Captain General of New Spain, so that His Excellency may protect the greater growth of these missions
2011590182.note: Spanish abbreviations were read as words, scrambling the sentence: Ro. Pe. F. is Reverendo Padre Fray, Exmo. Sr. Dn. is Excelentísimo Señor Don, 'su ex' is 'su Excelencia', and 'tubo' is tuvo (had/undertook), so Menchero is the subject who did the work, not a man 'travelling with information'. 'Corta obra' is 'short work'. The Franco in Juan Franco. is Francisco. Güemes y Orcasitas (Horcasitas) is the viceroy's name and stays. The pool caption is the archive's text with 'Espana' for España.

2013593011.title: The empire and expeditions of Alexander the Great
2013593011.note: Latin, never translated. Alexandri magni is genitive: of Alexander the Great.

2013593035.title: Persia, Arabia, etc.
2013593035.note: Language misdetected as Indonesian. '&c' is the period abbreviation for et cetera; it was left as '& c'. Persia and Arabia are the names of the regions, not 'Persian Arabia'.

2017585635.title: New world map
2017585635.note: French: 'Mappe monde' is a world map (mappemonde), not a 'Mappe' of a 'New World'; 'nouvelle' qualifies the map, not the world.

2017585646.title: New delineation of the whole world
2017585646.note: Latin, never translated. Orbis terrarum is the whole world (circle of the lands); totius is 'of the whole'.

2017585658.was: Mappe-monde, dressé sur les observations de mrs. de l'Academie royale des sciences et quelques autres et sur les memoires les plus recens
2017585658.title: World map, drawn up from the observations of the gentlemen of the Royal Academy of Sciences and some others, and from the most recent memoirs
2017585658.note: 'Mappe-monde' is a world map, not 'Mappe-world'. 'Mrs.' is the period abbreviation of messieurs (gentlemen), not the English title. 'Dressé' is drawn up, and 'memoires' are scientific memoirs. The earlier rendering was also cut off with an ellipsis; this is the full text.

2017585675.was: Mappa totius mundi : adornata juxta observationes dnn. academiae regalis scientiarum et nonnullorum aliorum secundum annotationes recentissimas
2017585675.title: Map of the whole world: arranged according to the observations of the gentlemen of the Royal Academy of Sciences and some others, following the most recent annotations
2017585675.note: Latin, never translated. Dnn. abbreviates dominorum (of the gentlemen); academiae regalis scientiarum is the Royal Academy of Sciences. The archive re-catalogued the title and the old truncated form no longer applies. It is the Latin counterpart of the French Mappe-monde of the same plate.

2017585680.was: Mappe-monde, dressé sur les observations de mrs. de l'Academie royale des sciences et quelques autres et sur les memoires les plus recens
2017585680.title: World map, drawn up from the observations of the gentlemen of the Royal Academy of Sciences and some others, and from the most recent memoirs
2017585680.note: 'Mappe-monde' is a world map, not 'Mappe-world'. 'Mrs.' is the period abbreviation of messieurs (gentlemen). The earlier rendering was also cut off with an ellipsis; this is the full text.

2021668266.title: Susŏn chŏndo
2021668266.note: Korean in McCune-Reischauer romanization, wrongly detected as Spanish and rendered 'Reg'. The romanization is kept: chŏndo is 'complete map', but Susŏn could stand for several Sino-Korean words and the caption carries nothing to choose between them, so no gloss is invented.

2021668267.was: Da Qing yi tong tian xia quan tu
2021668267.title: Complete map of all under heaven, unified under the Great Qing
2021668267.note: Chinese pinyin, never translated. Da Qing is the Great Qing (the dynasty), yi tong is 'unified', tian xia is 'all under heaven' (the empire/world), quan tu is 'complete map'.

2021668465.was: Map of the City and Bay of Cartagena de las Indias.
2021668465.title: Map of the City and Bay of Cartagena de las Indias
2021668465.note: Already English; it was flagged only because language detection failed. Only the trailing period is dropped. Cartagena de las Indias is a place name and stays Spanish.

2021668713.title: Portolan Chart
2021668713.note: Already English; flagged only because language detection failed. Only the trailing period is dropped.

74691151.was: Plan de la ville des Cayes, dans l'Isle Saint Domingue
74691151.title: Plan of the town of Les Cayes, on the island of Saint-Domingue
74691151.note: 'Plan de la ville' is a town plan. Les Cayes and Saint-Domingue are names; 'Isle' was left as an old French spelling of île.

74692109.was: Carte nouvelle de l'Amérique angloise contenant tout ce que les Anglois possédent sur le continent de l'Amérique septentrionale savoir le Canada, la Nouvelle Ecosse ou Acadie, les treize provinces unies qui font: les quatres colonies de la Nouvelle Angleterre
74692109.title: New map of English America, containing all that the English possess on the continent of North America, namely Canada, Nova Scotia or Acadia, and the thirteen united provinces, which are the four colonies of New England
74692109.note: 'Anglois' is English, not 'Anglos'; 'savoir' is 'namely', which the translator took as the verb 'know'. The earlier rendering also stopped at 'Canada'. The caption itself breaks off mid-list in the archive after 'les quatres colonies de la Nouvelle Angleterre', so that is where this ends.

74692148.was: Carte réduite des côtes orientales de l'Amérique septentrionale. Contenant celles des provinces de New-York et de la Nouvelle Angleterre, celles de l'Acadie ou Nouvelle Ecosse, de I'Île Royale de I'Île St. Jean, avec l'interieur du pays
74692148.title: Reduced chart of the eastern coasts of North America, containing those of the provinces of New York and New England, those of Acadia or Nova Scotia, of Île Royale and Île Saint-Jean, with the interior of the country
74692148.note: The earlier rendering was cut off before Acadia. Île Royale (Cape Breton) and Île Saint-Jean (Prince Edward Island) are names and stay in their period forms. 'Carte réduite' is a small-scale chart.

74693118.was: L'Amérique septentrionale, ou se remarquent les Etats Unis
74693118.title: North America, in which the United States are shown
74693118.note: 'Ou' is 'where/in which', not 'or', and 'se remarquent' is 'are to be seen'. The earlier rendering made the United States an alternative name for North America.

74693456.was: L'ancien et le nouveau Méxique, avec la Floride et la Basse Louisiane, partie orientale
74693456.title: Old and New Mexico, with Florida and Lower Louisiana, eastern part
74693456.note: Reads fine in the earlier rendering except for the loss of the article sense; 'Basse Louisiane' is Lower Louisiana. Rewritten against the archive text.

74693877.title: The English dominions in North America
74693877.note: Latin, never translated. Dominia Anglorum is the dominions of the English; America Septentrionali is North America.

74695633.was: Carta nautica que comprehende los Desembocaderos al mar del norte viniendo de la Jamaica, y de la isla de Santo Domingo
74695633.title: Nautical chart comprising the passages out to the Mar del Norte, coming from Jamaica and from the island of Santo Domingo
74695633.note: 'Comprehende' is 'comprises', not 'compresses'; 'desembocaderos' are outlets or passages (cf. the French débouquemens), not 'Retirement'. Mar del Norte was the Spanish name for the Atlantic on the Caribbean side, so 'North Sea' misleads and is kept as the name. Santo Domingo is a name.

84697512.was: Shinkoku fukui butoku anmin, Okatame taihei kagami : Izu, Sagami, Musashi, Awa, Kazusa, Shimōsa
84697512.title: Shinkoku fukui butoku anmin, Okatame taihei kagami: Izu, Sagami, Musashi, Awa, Kazusa, Shimōsa
84697512.note: Japanese romanization, never translated. Izu, Sagami, Musashi, Awa, Kazusa and Shimōsa are provinces and stay as names. The first half of the title could not be segmented reliably from the romanization alone, so it is left as catalogued rather than guessed at; needs someone who reads the original characters.

88691872.title: Map of Bhāratavarsha (India) in the time of the Mahābhārata
88691872.note: Marathi in romanization, never translated. Mahābhārata-kālīna is 'of the time of the Mahābhārata'; Bhāratavarsha is the classical name for India; nakāśā is 'map'.

96686640.was: La Californie ou Nouvelle Caroline : teatro de los trabajos, Apostolicos de la Compa. e Jesus en la America Septe
96686640.title: California, or New Caroline: theatre of the apostolic labours of the Society of Jesus in North America
96686640.note: Mixed French/Spanish title. 'Teatro de los trabajos Apostolicos de la Compa. e Jesus' is 'theatre of the apostolic labours of the Society of Jesus' (Compañía de Jesús, the Jesuits); the translator took 'Compa.' as a name and 'Septe' as the word 'know'. The archive's text is cut off at 'Septe', almost certainly Septentrional, so North America.

98685607.was: Charte von den Vereinigten Staaten von Nord-America nebst Louisiana : nach Murdochischer projection entworfen nach den neuesten astronomischen ortsbestimmungen
98685607.title: Chart of the United States of North America together with Louisiana, drawn in Murdoch's projection according to the latest astronomical determinations of position
98685607.note: German, never translated. 'Nebst' is 'together with'; 'Murdochischer projection' is the conic projection of Patrick Murdoch, a person's name; 'ortsbestimmungen' are determinations of position. The archive re-catalogued the title longer than before.

98687119.was: La Californie ou Nouvelle Caroline : teatro de los trabajos, Apostolicos de la Compa. e Jesus en la America Septe
98687119.title: California, or New Caroline: theatre of the apostolic labours of the Society of Jesus in North America
98687119.note: Mixed French/Spanish title. 'Teatro de los trabajos Apostolicos de la Compa. e Jesus' is 'theatre of the apostolic labours of the Society of Jesus' (Compañía de Jesús, the Jesuits); the translator took 'Compa.' as a name and 'Septe' as the word 'know'. The archive's text is cut off at 'Septe', almost certainly Septentrional, so North America.

99446187.was: La Palestine, les tribus, et Jerusalem
99446187.title: Palestine, the Tribes, and Jerusalem
99446187.note: Earlier rendering was essentially right; rewritten against the archive text. 'Tribes' means the twelve tribes of Israel.

gm71005066.title: Complete map of the front and rear mountains of Taiwan (Taiwan qian hou shan quan tu)
gm71005066.note: Chinese pinyin in square brackets, never translated. Quan tu is 'complete map'; qian shan and hou shan are the 'front' (west) and 'rear' (east) mountain regions either side of the Central Range. Taiwan is a name. The archive re-catalogued it with brackets.

2002622264.was: Carte de l'Amerique Septentrionnale : depuis le 25, jusqu'au 65⁰ deg. de latt. & environ 140, & 235 deg. de longitude / par Iean Baptiste Louis Franquelin, hydrographe du roy, à Québec en Canada
2002622264.title: Map of North America: from the 25th to the 65th degree of latitude, and approximately from 140 to 235 degrees of longitude / by Jean Baptiste Louis Franquelin, royal hydrographer, at Québec in Canada
2002622264.note: Never translated: the pool held the French catalogue title verbatim, so the flag changed nothing a reader saw. Carte = map; Septentrionnale = northern (the whole continent, i.e. North America); 'depuis le 25, jusqu'au 65 deg. de latt.' = from the 25th to the 65th degree of latitude; 'environ 140, & 235 deg. de longitude' = roughly 140 to 235 degrees of longitude (counted eastward from a prime meridian, hence the large numbers). Iean is period spelling of Jean; Franquelin, Québec and Canada are names and kept as such; 'hydrographe du roy' = the King's hydrographer.

2021668287.title: Huang Qing di li tu (Geographical Maps of the Qing Empire)
2021668287.note: Language detector tagged this pinyin romanization as Indonesian ('id'), so the catalogue's own words were published with a stray full stop and no English. It is Chinese: Huang Qing = Imperial Qing, di li = geography, tu = maps. Gloss taken from the record's own description (compiled by Dong Youcheng, 1856); the romanized title is kept as the title, not translated away.

99447692.title: Map of the Communication Routes of Asiatic Russia
99447692.note: Language detector read transliterated Russian as Latvian ('lv') and the translator returned 'Member of the Commission', apparently from the issuing body's name, not the title. Karta = map; puteĭ soobshchenīi︠a︡ = ways/lines of communication (the Russian ministry's term for railways, waterways and roads, matching the record's description); Azīatskoĭ Rossīi = of Asiatic Russia (Siberia and Central Asia).

90682666.was: Plano de la Bahía de Concepción de Chile situada la ciudad antigua en latitud meridional de 36°42ʹ53ʺ y en longitud de 303°52ʹ3ʺ de Tenerife observadas astronómicamente
90682666.title: Plan of the Bay of Concepción in Chile, with the old city situated at south latitude 36°42ʹ53ʺ and longitude 303°52ʹ3ʺ from Tenerife, astronomically observed
90682666.note: Never translated properly: the archive's Spanish title was machine-read as English, so 'Plano' became 'Plane' (it is a plan/map), 'Bahia de Concepción' was left half-Spanish, 'latitud meridional' (meridional = southern in Spanish) became 'South latitude' only by luck while 'longitud ... de Tenerife' became 'at length', and the minute and second marks (ʹ and ʺ) were garbled into 'ю'. 'de Tenerife' means the longitude is reckoned from the Tenerife meridian (old Spanish/French practice, hence 303°), not a place name to drop. Concepción and Tenerife are names and are kept.

2003623373.was: Plan général du Fort Septentrional du Detour des Anglois, tel qu'il est présentement : [Louisiana]
2003623373.title: General plan of the Northern Fort at the Detour des Anglois, as it presently stands: [Louisiana]
2003623373.note: Detour des Anglois is the English Turn, the bend of the Mississippi below New Orleans, and is a place name to keep as written; the translator turned it into 'Detour des Anglos', a form that exists in no language. Also, 'tel qu'il est présentement' is 'as it presently stands', and the archive's bracketed [Louisiana] is a cataloguer's place note that was reduced to a bare 'Louisiana' with its brackets lost.

2013593017.title: Southwest Asia: possessions of European Powers
2013593017.note: Caption was never translated; the archive's title is a French/German-style hybrid. 'Sudwest-Asien' is German for Southwest Asia; the rest was already English. Translated the German part only and added nothing.

2008629058.was: Carta topografica della Colonia Eritrea alla scala di 1:100,000
2008629058.title: Topographic map of the Colony of Eritrea at a scale of 1:100,000
2008629058.note: Translation was mostly right but left 'Colonia Eritrea' (Italian) untranslated. Eritrea is a name and stays; 'Colonia' is the common noun, so 'Colony of Eritrea'. Scale unchanged.

2021668455.title: Valentia Edetanorum, the Plebs of the Cid
2021668455.note: Never translated. Valentia Edetanorum is the Roman name of Valencia (Spain), a place name kept as is. 'Plebs of Cid' is the archive's own wording, a Latin 'plebs' (common people / commonalty) of the Cid; rendered as 'the Plebs of the Cid' without adding detail the caption does not carry.

73697045.was: Le golfe de St. Laurent dressé sur plusieurs arpentages modernes et autres matériaux liés par des observations astronomiques
73697045.title: The Gulf of St. Lawrence, drawn from several modern surveys and other materials linked by astronomical observations
73697045.note: French 'dressé sur' (drawn up from, compiled on the basis of) was dropped, leaving a sentence with no verb; the French title 'Le golfe de St. Laurent' was also left in French. St. Laurent is the Gulf of St. Lawrence.

2006629148.was: [Iconografica rappresentatione della inclita città di Venezia consacrata al reggio serenissimo dominio veneto]
2006629148.title: Iconographic representation of the renowned city of Venice, consecrated to the most serene Venetian dominion
2006629148.note: 'inclita' is Italian for illustrious/renowned (from Latin inclitus), not 'inclined'; 'reggio' is a period spelling of 'regio' (royal/sovereign) and was dropped; 'serenissimo dominio veneto' is the formal style of the Venetian Republic. Iconografica rappresentatione = iconographic representation (a view), not 'Iconograph'.

2013593003.was: Carte de la Turquie D'Asie, de la Perse: de l'Afghanistan, du Belouchistan et de la grande Boukharie; avec une partie des Etats voisins
2013593003.title: Map of Asiatic Turkey, Persia, Afghanistan, Baluchistan and Greater Bukhara, with part of the neighbouring states
2013593003.note: Never translated. The pool's caption was re-catalogued to add 'avec une partie des Etats voisins', so 'was' is the new wording. Belouchistan = Baluchistan; 'la grande Boukharie' = Greater Bukhara (Great Bukharia), a historical region of Central Asia. Place names kept as names.

2002622263.was: Amérique septentrion.lle [i.e. septentrionale] : composée, corigée, et augmētée, sur les iournaux, mémoires, et observations les plus justes qui en ón'́etes.tes en l'année 1685 & 1686, par plusieurs particuliés
2002622263.title: North America: composed, corrected and augmented from the most accurate journals, memoirs and observations that were made of it in the years 1685 & 1686, by several individuals
2002622263.note: The translator mangled the French word by word: corigée became 'corrigerated', augmētée (macron for n) became 'aggmated', 'iournaux' (i for j) was left as 'iurnals', septentrionale ('northern', here North America) was left half French, and the rendering stopped at 'memoirs', dropping the rest. The archive's text is itself garbled in 'qui en ón'́etes.tes'; read here as 'qui en ont été faites' (that were made of it), which is a reconstruction.

2002623130.was: A mapp of Virginia discovered to ye hills, and in it's latt. from 35 deg. & 1/2 neer Florida to 41 deg. bounds of New England
2002623130.title: A map of Virginia discovered to the hills, and in its latitude from 35½ degrees near Florida to 41 degrees, the bounds of New England
2002623130.note: Already English but never rendered readable: 'mapp', 'ye' (= the, from the thorn abbreviation) and 'it's' are period spelling. 'deg. & 1/2' is 35½ degrees. The pool's caption was re-catalogued with the latitudes, so 'was' is the new wording.

2003623401.title: Havana on the island of Cuba
2003623401.note: Never translated. Dutch 'op 't Eyland' = on the island; 'Cvba' is Cuba in the classical u/v spelling, not a word. Havana is the city and Cuba the island; both kept as names.

2003626426.was: Universalis cosmographia secundum Ptholomaei traditionem et Americi Vespucii alioru[m]que lustrationes
2003626426.title: Universal cosmography according to the tradition of Ptolemy and the voyages of Amerigo Vespucci and others
2003626426.note: Never translated. Latin 'lustrationes' is surveys or journeys of exploration (lustrare, to traverse), not 'purifications'. Ptholomaei is Ptolemy; Americi Vespucii is Amerigo Vespucci. The pool's caption was re-catalogued with 'alioru[m]que' (editorial brackets for a missing m), so 'was' is the new wording.

2003627035.was: Übersichts-Blatt Afghanistan und den Ländern an der Nord-West Grenze Von Indien
2003627035.title: Overview sheet of Afghanistan and the countries on the north-west frontier of India
2003627035.note: German 'Übersichts-Blatt' is an overview (index) sheet. The old rendering dropped the genitive: 'Afghanistan und den Ländern' is 'of Afghanistan and of the countries', and 'Grenze' on a colonial map is the frontier. India's 'Von' is capitalised only by cataloguing.

2004629175.was: Expeditionis Hispanorum in Angliam vera descriptio. Anno Do: M D LXXXVIII
2004629175.title: True depiction of the Spanish expedition against England. In the year of the Lord 1588
2004629175.note: Never translated. 'Anno Do:' abbreviates Anno Domini, and 'M D LXXXVIII' is 1588 (the Armada), so it is the date, not a name. 'Hispanorum' = of the Spaniards; 'in Angliam' = against/into England.

2005625331.was: L'Afrique, ou Lybie ulterieure : ou font le Saara, or desért, le pays des Negres, la Guinee, et les pays circonv., tirée en partie de Sanut, et de l'Arabe du Nubie : en partie de diverses cartes veues, jusques a present : la coste de Negres, et Guinee, &c. est apres les observations de Samuel Blomart
2005625331.title: Africa, or Further Libya: where lie the Sahara, or desert, the land of the Negroes, Guinea and the neighbouring countries, drawn partly from Sanut and from the Arabic of the Nubian, partly from various maps seen up to now; the coast of the Negroes and Guinea, &c., is after the observations of Samuel Blomart
2005625331.note: Several faults. The long-s 'ſont' (are) was read as 'font' and rendered 'make'; 'Lybie ulterieure' is Libya Ulterior, Further Libya, not 'later Libya'; 'circonv.' abbreviates circonvoisins (neighbouring); 'Sanut' is the geographer Sanudo and 'l'Arabe du Nubie' the Arabic text of the Nubian (Nubian geographer), both names. The translation stopped after 'circonv. countries', dropping the sources and Samuel Blomart. 'Negres' is the period term in the source and is kept as written.

2006627252.was: Orbis terrarum nova et accuratissima tabula
2006627252.title: New and most accurate map of the world
2006627252.note: Never translated. 'Orbis terrarum' = the circle of the lands, i.e. the world; 'tabula' = map (table, plate), 'accuratissima' = most accurate.

2006627324.was: Direction des Iles du Vent, Ile de Tabago, 1er germinal an 11 : plan du fort Scarborough ci-devant de Castries, tel qu'il a été livre'aux troupes françaises, par les Anglais, le 15. vendémiaire an 11
2006627324.title: Windward Islands Directorate, Island of Tobago, 1 Germinal Year 11: plan of Fort Scarborough, formerly Fort Castries, as it was handed over to the French troops by the English, 15 Vendémiaire Year 11
2006627324.note: Translation stopped after '1st germinal year 11', dropping the plan, the fort and the handover. Germinal and Vendémiaire are months of the French Republican calendar (Year 11 is 1802-03) and are kept as names. 'Iles du Vent' = Windward Islands; 'ci-devant de Castries' = formerly (called) Castries; Scarborough and Castries are names.

2007628530.title: Complete map of Xizang (Tibet)
2007628530.note: The source is pinyin, Xizang quan tu (Tibet, complete map), mis-detected as Vietnamese; the translator invented 'Xizang Yuan'. Xizang is the Chinese name of Tibet, kept as a name. 'quan tu' read as 'complete map' (full-sheet map); this is the standard reading of those syllables, with no characters in the record to confirm.

2008628167.was: [Portolan chart of the Pacific coast from Mexico to northern Chile]
2008628167.title: Portolan chart of the Pacific coast from Mexico to northern Chile
2008628167.note: Already English. The only issue was the cataloguer's square brackets, which mark a supplied title rather than one on the map; they are dropped from the displayed caption.

2010592453.was: Exquisita & magno aliquot mensium periculo lustrata et iam retecta Freti Magellanici facies : eijgentlicke asbeeldinghe der Magellanischer Strate die nu met veel gevaers eitelijeke Maenden doorsien van nieus ondecktis
2010592453.title: Choice view of the Strait of Magellan, surveyed at great risk over several months and now newly uncovered: true depiction of the Strait of Magellan, which with much danger over some months has been examined and newly discovered
2010592453.note: Never translated. Latin and Dutch say the same thing: 'Exquisita...facies' = a choice/excellent aspect (view); 'lustrata' = surveyed; 'retecta' = uncovered; Dutch 'eijgentlicke asbeeldinghe' = true depiction (afbeelding), 'doorsien' = examined, 'van nieus ondecktis' = newly discovered. Strait of Magellan kept as a place name. The pool's caption was re-catalogued with the Dutch half, so 'was' is the new wording.

2017585967.title: New Netherland and New England
2017585967.note: Latin names left as Latin. Nova Belgica is New Netherland (Belgica for the Low Countries), and Anglia Nova is New England; both are places, so the reader needs the English names.

2021668427.was: A Chart of Magellan by the Route of Tierra del Fuego.
2021668427.title: A Chart of Magellan by the Route of Tierra del Fuego
2021668427.note: Already English; only the trailing catalogue full stop is dropped. Tierra del Fuego kept as a name.

2021668433.was: The Drawing of the Modern Geography of the Whole Africa.
2021668433.title: The Drawing of the Modern Geography of the Whole of Africa

73696624.title: North America, published in France by Monsieur d'Anville, now in England; with the colonies extended into the interior of Virginia, the course of the River Ohio added, and illustrated with geographical and historical notes
73696624.note: Never translated; the archive's own Latin, rendered. 'Galliis' is a variant spelling of Gallis (in France); 'edita' = published; 'Coloniis in interiorem Virginiam deductis' = colonies led out into inland Virginia; 'Fluvii Ohio cursu aucta' = enlarged with the course of the Ohio.
