74696149.was: Mapa maritimo del Golfo de Mexico e islas de la America, para el uso de los navegantes en esta parte del mundo, construido sobre las mexores memorias, y observaciones astronomicas de longitudes, y latitudes
74696149.title: Maritime map of the Gulf of Mexico and the islands of America, for the use of navigators in this part of the world, constructed upon the best memoirs and astronomical observations of longitudes and latitudes
74696149.note: Never translated; the archive's own Spanish, rendered. 'mexores' is an old spelling of 'mejores' (best); 'memorias' here means memoirs/reports, not memories. 'Mapa maritimo' = sea chart.

2006626081.title: Bermuda Hundred, 1864–1865
2006626081.note: Never translated; English already. The archive re-catalogued the title with the date in square brackets ('[1864-1865]', a cataloguer-supplied date of the campaign, not part of the map's own title). Bermuda Hundred is a place name (the Virginia peninsula at the James and Appomattox rivers), kept as a name. Bracket dropped for display.

2008626932.was: Carte du Lac Champlain depuis le Fort Chambly jusqu'a celuyde St. Fréderic
2008626932.title: Map of Lake Champlain from Fort Chambly to that of St. Frédéric
2008626932.note: 'celuyde' is 'celuy de' (old spelling of 'celui de', 'that of') run together; the translator left it as if it were a place. It stands for the fort of St. Frédéric, so 'that of St. Frédéric'. Fort Chambly and St. Frédéric are names, kept.

2013593005.title: Marittima Italiana: Bombay Line
2013593005.note: 'Marittima Italiana' is the name of an Italian shipping company (founded 1936, per the record's description), not a phrase to translate. The translator rendered it 'Italian Maritime'. 'Linea di Bombay' = Bombay Line.

2017585659.was: Mappe-monde, carte universelle de la terre : dressee sur les relations les plus nouvelles soumises aux observations astronomiques les plus recentes ou sont marqueés les nouvelles découvertes
2017585659.title: World map, universal map of the earth: drawn up from the newest accounts, subject to the most recent astronomical observations, in which the new discoveries are marked
2017585659.note: Two faults. 'Mappe-monde' is 'world map' (the translator produced 'Mappe-world'), and 'relations' here means accounts/reports, not 'relationships'. 'dressee' = drawn up, not 'sets up'. The published line was also cut off before 'ou sont marqueés les nouvelles découvertes' (in which the new discoveries are marked); 'ou' is 'où'.

2021668269.was: Qing nei fu yu di tu suo mo ben
2021668269.title: Qing nei fu yu di tu suo mo ben (Reduced Copy of the Qing Imperial Household Maps of the Realm)
2021668269.note: Chinese in pinyin, mis-tagged as Italian, so the translator split it into English-looking syllables ('Qing in the yu fu of you his mo well'). Read as pinyin (Qing neifu yudi tu suomo ben): Qing = the dynasty, neifu = Imperial Household, yudi tu = maps of the land, suomo ben = reduced copy/facsimile. The characters are not in the record, so this reading is from the romanisation; the romanisation is kept so it can be checked.

73695752.was: Partie de l'Amérique septent? qui comprend la Nouvelle France ou le Canada,
73695752.title: Part of North America which includes New France or Canada
73695752.note: Source is truncated by the catalogue: 'septent?' stands for 'septentrionale' (northern), so 'North America'. The earlier rendering was right in sense but gave no sign the source was cut off. New France is a name, kept.

73696225.was: Plan de la ville de Louisbourg dans l'Isle Royale
73696225.title: Plan of the town of Louisbourg on Île Royale
73696225.note: 'Plan' is a town plan, not a 'map'. Louisbourg and Île Royale (French name for Cape Breton Island) are names; the translator anglicised Île Royale to 'Isle Royale', which is a different place (in Lake Superior).

74690808.was: Carte du Golphe du Méxique et des isles de l'Amérique. Pour servir à l'Histoire générale des voyages
74690808.title: Map of the Gulf of Mexico and the islands of America. To accompany the Histoire générale des voyages
74690808.note: 'Golphe' is old French for 'golfe' (gulf); the translator read it as 'Golf'. 'Histoire générale des voyages' is the title of a published work (Prévost's collection of voyages), not a phrase meaning 'general travel history', so it is kept as a title. 'Pour servir à' = to accompany/serve.

74693106.was: Carte réduite des côtes orientales de l'Amérique septentrionale. Contenant celles des provinces de New-York et de la Nouvelle Angleterre, celles de l'Acadie ou Nouvelle Ecosse de l'Île Royale de l'Île St. Jean avec l'intérieur du pays
74693106.title: Reduced chart of the eastern coasts of North America. Containing those of the provinces of New York and New England, those of Acadia or Nova Scotia, Île Royale and Île Saint-Jean, with the interior of the country
74693106.note: The published line stopped after 'New England' and dropped Acadia or Nova Scotia, Île Royale, Île St. Jean and the interior. 'Carte réduite' is a nautical term for a chart on a reduced (Mercator) projection, so 'chart'. Place names kept.

74695307.was: Amérique septentrionale, dressée sur les relations les plus modernes des voyageurs et navigateurs, et divisée suivant les differentes possessions des européens
74695307.title: North America, drawn up from the most recent accounts of travellers and navigators, and divided according to the different possessions of the Europeans
74695307.note: 'dressée' = drawn up, not 'built'; 'relations' = accounts/reports, not 'relations'; 'modernes' = recent. The published line was cut off before 'and divided according to the different possessions of the Europeans'.

96687322.was: Carte de la riviere Longue : et de quelques autres, qui se dechargent dans le grand fleuve de Missisipi [sic] ... ; Carte que les Gnacsitares : ont dessine sur des paux de cerfs
96687322.title: Map of the Long River, and of some others which empty into the great river Mississippi [sic] ...; Map that the Gnacsitares drew on deerskins
96687322.note: 'se dechargent dans' = flow/empty into, not 'is set in'. 'paux de cerfs' is the catalogue's slip for 'peaux de cerfs', deerskins. 'Gnacsitares' is the name of a people (Lahontan's invented/recorded nation), kept as a name. The second map, the one drawn by the Gnacsitares, was dropped from the published line.

99446218.title: Egypt and Arabia Petraea
99446218.note: Never translated; already English. The archive's 'petræa' uses the æ ligature, spelled 'Petraea' for display (Arabia Petraea, the Roman province, a name). Flag only brought the same text back, so this is the replacement.

2001622423.was: Mapa de toda la frontera de los dominios del rey en la America septentrional
2001622423.title: Map of the whole frontier of the King's dominions in North America
2001622423.note: 'frontera' is frontier, not 'border', and 'de los dominios del rey' = of the King's dominions; the published line dropped the article and made it 'King's domains'. 'America septentrional' = North America. The record's description places this in New Spain.

73691837.was: Carte de l'isle de la Jamaique
73691837.title: Map of the Island of Jamaica
73691837.note: Barely wrong: 'Isle' is the old French form of 'île' and reads as a name fragment in English, and 'Jamaique' is Jamaica. Rendered as 'Island of Jamaica'.

74694520.was: Plan of the Isle aux Noix, in the River Richelieu, and Province of Canada
74694520.title: Plan of the Isle aux Noix, in the River Richelieu, and Province of Canada
74694520.note: Already English; the language detector was misled by the French place names. Isle aux Noix and the Richelieu are names and stay. Text is unchanged on purpose; the correction records that it was checked.

75572478.was: Korte beschryvinge van de landschappen des werelts enz
75572478.title: Short description of the regions of the world, etc.
75572478.note: Dutch. 'werelts' is the old genitive of 'wereld' (world); the translator read it as 'past'. 'landschappen' = regions/provinces, not 'landscapes'. 'Korte beschryvinge' = short description; 'enz' = etc.

2004629150.was: Colton's Japan : Nippon, Kiusiu, Sikok, Yesso and the Japanese Kuriles
2004629150.title: Colton's Japan: Nippon, Kiusiu, Sikok, Yesso and the Japanese Kuriles
2004629150.note: Already English. The spacing before the colon is tidied. Nippon, Kiusiu, Sikok and Yesso are the period spellings of Honshu, Kyushu, Shikoku and Hokkaido as lettered on the map; kept as names, not modernised.

2006629341.was: [Manuṣyaloka, map of the world of man, according to Jain cosomological traditions]
2006629341.title: [Manuṣyaloka, map of the world of man, according to Jain cosmological traditions]
2006629341.note: Already English and never translated; the only fault is the archive's typo 'cosomological', corrected to 'cosmological'. Manuṣyaloka is the Jain 'world of man' and is kept as a name. Brackets are the cataloguer's, marking a supplied title.

2008621654.title: Map of Indo-China
2008621654.note: French, never translated, so the flag left French on the panel. Indo-China is the French colonial region (Vietnam, Laos, Cambodia), kept hyphenated as the source has it.

2021668280.title: Map of Ezo.
2021668280.note: Already English; the flag recorded no reason. Ezo is the old name for Hokkaido and its surrounding lands, kept as a name.

2021668292.was: Division of the Land of Israel Within its Borders: Copied from the Great Luminary, the Famous and Pious Gaon, Our Teacher and Rabbi, Rabbi Eliyahu from Vilna, the Capital.
2021668292.title: Division of the Land of Israel Within its Borders: Copied from the Great Luminary, the Famous and Pious Gaon, Our Teacher and Rabbi, Rabbi Eliyahu from Vilna, the Capital.
2021668292.note: Already English; the flag recorded no reason. Left as catalogued: 'Gaon' is a title, and the person is Rabbi Eliyahu of Vilna (the Vilna Gaon), so no name is altered.

2021668533.was: European Turkey and Part of Asian Turkey, Divided into Large Provinces and Governorships.
2021668533.title: European Turkey and Part of Asian Turkey, Divided into Large Provinces and Governorships.
2021668533.note: Already English; the flag recorded no reason. Left as catalogued.

2021668643.was: Port of Louisbourg on Île Royale.
2021668643.title: Port of Louisbourg on Île Royale.
2021668643.note: Already English; the flag recorded no reason. Louisbourg and Île Royale (now Cape Breton Island) are names, left as catalogued.

2024592846.was: Apographon descriptionis Orbis terrae, figuris et narratinunculis distinctae, manu Germanica opere nigelliari discolorio circa medium saec. XV. Tabulae aeneae Musei Borgiani Velitris consignatae, quod Camillus Joh. Paulii F. Borgia, Cruce Hieros. ornatus, ab intimo cubiculo Electoris Bavarici, Patrui Cardinalis exempla imitatus, summa fide, maximoque artificio expressum, recognitumque eruditis spectandum proponit A.C. MDCCXCVII
2024592846.title: Copy of a description of the world, set out in figures and little narratives, in a German hand, in varicoloured niello work, around the middle of the 15th century. Preserved on the bronze plates of the Borgia Museum at Velletri; Camillo, son of Giovanni Paolo Borgia, decorated with the Cross of Jerusalem, of the private chamber of the Elector of Bavaria, imitating the examples of his uncle the Cardinal, sets it before the learned to behold, rendered with the greatest fidelity and artistry and revised. AD 1797
2024592846.note: Latin, never translated. 'Apographon' is a copy of an original; 'opere nigelliari discolorio' is niello (black-inlay) work in varied colours; 'patrui Cardinalis' is the uncle Cardinal (Stefano Borgia); 'A.C. MDCCXCVII' is the year 1797. Borgia, Velletri, Bavaria and the Cross of Jerusalem kept as names. Reading of 'tabulae aeneae' as bronze plates and of the Latin's clause order is a best reading; check against the original if it matters.

73696674.was: Vorstellung einiger Gegenden und Plaetze in Nord-America unter Franzoesisch und Englische Jurisdiction gehoerig
73696674.title: View of some regions and places in North America belonging under French and English jurisdiction
73696674.note: German (old spelling: Franzoesisch, Englische, gehoerig). 'Vorstellung' is a depiction or view, not a 'presentation', and 'gehoerig' (belonging to) was dropped.

73697197.was: Carta reducida de las islas Lucayas, ò de los Lucayos
73697197.title: Reduced chart of the Lucayas Islands, or the Lucayos
73697197.note: Spanish. 'Carta reducida' is a reduced (Mercator) sea chart, not a small letter; the accented 'ò' is the old 'o' meaning 'or' but was left as a stray character; and 'islas' was lost. Lucayas/Lucayos are two names for the same islands (the Bahamas), so they are kept, not translated.

86692266.was: Chart of the coast of Maine
86692266.title: Chart of the coast of Maine
86692266.note: Already English; the flag recorded no reason. Left as catalogued.

98687117.was: Central-Afrika nach den neuesten Forschungen bearbeitet von Dr. Joseph Chavanne
98687117.title: Central Africa, compiled from the latest research by Dr. Joseph Chavanne
98687117.note: German, 'Central-Afrika nach den neuesten Forschungen bearbeitet von Dr. Joseph Chavanne'. 'Bearbeitet' is compiled/revised (a cartographer working from others' explorations) rather than 'edited'; the earlier rendering also lost the comma. Joseph Chavanne is the Austrian geographer, kept as a name.

99446169.was: Carte réduite des découvertes des Russes, entre l'Asie et l'Amerique
99446169.title: Reduced chart of the Russian discoveries between Asia and America
99446169.note: French. 'Carte réduite' is a technical term for a Mercator sea chart, not a map that has been shrunk; the earlier version translated it as 'Reduced map'.

rijks:NG-1994-33-1.title: Map of West Java
rijks:NG-1994-33-1.note: Dutch, never translated. 'Kaart van West-Java'; West Java is a place name.

rijks:NG-1998-9.was: Kaart van de aanval op Elmina, 1828
rijks:NG-1998-9.title: Map of the attack on Elmina, 1828
rijks:NG-1998-9.note: Dutch, never translated. Elmina is the Dutch Gold Coast fort-town (now in Ghana), kept as a name.

rijks:NG-501-39.was: Kaart van Franse kust bij La Rochelle en de eilanden Ré en Oleron
rijks:NG-501-39.title: Map of the French coast near La Rochelle and the islands of Ré and Oléron
rijks:NG-501-39.note: Dutch, never translated. La Rochelle, Ré and Oléron are places; 'Oleron' is given its French accent.

rijks:RP-P-1905-214.was: Plattegrond van het fundament en de kelders van het Hotel des Invalides te Parijs
rijks:RP-P-1905-214.title: Ground plan of the foundations and cellars of the Hôtel des Invalides in Paris
rijks:RP-P-1905-214.note: Dutch, never translated. 'Plattegrond' is a ground plan, not a 'flat ground'. Hôtel des Invalides is a building and a name, not 'hotel'.

rijks:RP-P-1909-375.title: Siege of Breda, 1637
rijks:RP-P-1909-375.note: Dutch, never translated. Breda is a city name.

rijks:RP-P-1909-436.was: Kaart van het beleg van Breda, 1624-1625
rijks:RP-P-1909-436.title: Map of the siege of Breda, 1624–1625
rijks:RP-P-1909-436.note: Dutch, never translated. Breda is a city name; the date range is the siege of 1624–25.

rijks:RP-P-1910-2195.was: Kaart van het fort Crèvecoeur, veroverd door de Fransen in 1672
rijks:RP-P-1910-2195.title: Map of Fort Crèvecoeur, captured by the French in 1672
rijks:RP-P-1910-2195.note: Dutch, never translated. Crèvecoeur is the name of the fort and is not to be rendered as 'heartbreak'.

rijks:RP-P-1910-2226.was: Vestingplattegrond van Brussel, gebombardeerd door het Franse leger in 1695
rijks:RP-P-1910-2226.title: Fortification plan of Brussels, bombarded by the French army in 1695
rijks:RP-P-1910-2226.note: Dutch, never translated. 'Vestingplattegrond' is a plan of a fortified town. Brussels is a name; 1695 is the French bombardment.

rijks:RP-P-1911-2909.was: Kaart van Java met een plattegrond van Batavia
rijks:RP-P-1911-2909.title: Map of Java with a plan of Batavia
rijks:RP-P-1911-2909.note: Dutch, never translated. Batavia is the Dutch colonial name for Jakarta, kept as catalogued.

rijks:RP-P-1939-1429.was: Kaart van de Zuidengelse kust tussen de Isle of Wight en Dover
rijks:RP-P-1939-1429.title: Map of the south coast of England between the Isle of Wight and Dover
rijks:RP-P-1939-1429.note: Dutch, never translated. 'Zuidengelse' means southern English; Isle of Wight and Dover are names.

rijks:RP-P-AO-2-15C.title: Map of Friesland and Groningen
rijks:RP-P-AO-2-15C.note: Dutch, never translated. Friesland and Groningen are Dutch provinces, kept as names.

rijks:RP-P-AO-20-68.title: Plan of Amsterdam and surroundings
rijks:RP-P-AO-20-68.note: Dutch, never translated. 'Plattegrond' is a town plan.

rijks:RP-P-AO-20-69.title: Plan of Amsterdam and surroundings
rijks:RP-P-AO-20-69.note: Dutch, never translated. 'Plattegrond' is a town plan.

rijks:RP-P-AO-20-7B.title: Plan of Amsterdam, 1400
rijks:RP-P-AO-20-7B.note: Dutch, never translated. 'Plattegrond' is a town plan; the 1400 is the state of the city shown, not a publication date.

rijks:RP-P-OB-50.152.was: Kaart van de kust van Zweden tussen Kalmar en Stockholm
rijks:RP-P-OB-50.152.title: Map of the Swedish coast between Kalmar and Stockholm
rijks:RP-P-OB-50.152.note: Dutch, never translated. Kalmar and Stockholm are places.

rijks:RP-P-OB-77.076.was: Kaart van de provincies Holland, Utrecht en Gelderland met de vestingen en forten gebouwd tijdens de oorlog in 1672
rijks:RP-P-OB-77.076.title: Map of the provinces of Holland, Utrecht and Gelderland with the fortresses and forts built during the war in 1672
rijks:RP-P-OB-77.076.note: Dutch, never translated. 'Vestingen' are fortified towns/fortresses, 'forten' forts. Holland, Utrecht and Gelderland are provinces; 1672 is the Rampjaar.

rijks:RP-T-AO-7-9.was: Paskaart van het Marsdiep tussen Den Helder en Texel
rijks:RP-T-AO-7-9.title: Sailing chart of the Marsdiep between Den Helder and Texel
rijks:RP-T-AO-7-9.note: Dutch, never translated. 'Paskaart' is a sea or pilot chart; Marsdiep is the tidal channel, a name, not 'march deep'. Den Helder and Texel are places.

2001620482.title: Venice
2001620482.note: Venezia is the Italian name of Venice, left untranslated. The map is a Wagner & Debes plate of the city (Baedeker guidebook maps), so the English place name is Venice.

2003623388.title: North America
2003623388.note: Amérique septentrionale is French for North America. 'Septentrionale' (from septentrio, the north) was rendered as 'Northern', which drops the continent's name: 'Northern America' is not an English term and is not what the map shows.

2003627092.was: Carte de la découverte faite l'an 1673 dans l'Amérique septentrionale
2003627092.title: Map of the discovery made in 1673 in North America
2003627092.note: The published English was already accurate ('Amérique septentrionale' is North America); it was flagged because the same phrase was mistranslated as 'Northern America' on sibling map 2003623388. This is Marquette's chart of the 1673 Mississippi voyage, so the title is kept as translated and the correction just pins it.

2004629037.title: Persia, Afghanistan and Baluchistan
2004629037.note: The title is already English, but language detection guessed Indonesian and 'translated' it, turning Persia into 'Persian'. The archive's own words are correct as they stand.

2005630228.was: Noua, et integra uniuersi orbis descriptio
2005630228.title: Noua, et integra uniuersi orbis descriptio
2005630228.note: Latin title of Oronce Fine's 1531 world map (u for v, Noua for Nova). Detected as Catalan and machine-translated, which turned 'et' into 'you' and 'integra' into 'integrate'. Latin is kept as published; in English: 'A new and complete description of the whole world'.

2008621655.was: Kusae : auf grundlage der brit. u. deutsch. seekarte
2008621655.title: Kosrae: based on the British and German sea charts
2008621655.note: Kusae is the German spelling of Kosrae, the Micronesian island; the translator treated 'brit. u. deutsch.' as sentence-ending abbreviations ('British. u. German.'). 'u.' is 'und' (and), 'brit.' and 'deutsch.' are adjectives, and 'seekarte' is a sea (nautical) chart.

2013593004.was: Theatrum historicum ad annum Christi quadringentesimum : in quo tum Imperii Romani tum Barbarorum circum incolentium status ob oculosponitur pars orientalis
2013593004.title: Historical theatre for the year of Christ 400, in which the state of the Roman Empire and of the barbarians dwelling around it is set before the eyes: eastern part
2013593004.note: Latin, never translated. The re-catalogued title in the pool is 'Theatrum historicum ad annum Christi quadringentesimum : in quo tum Imperii Romani tum Barbarorum circum incolentium status ob oculosponitur pars orientalis'. 'oculosponitur' is the archive's run-together 'oculos ponitur' (is placed before the eyes). Guillaume de L'Isle's map, published by Senex.

2013593006.title: Western Asia
2013593006.note: Vorder-Asien is German for Western Asia (literally 'Fore-Asia', the German term for the Near East / Southwest Asia). Heinrich Kiepert map, Berlin 1855.

2021668585.was: Colonia Agrippina (Present-Day Cologne) Accurately Described in the Year 1571.
2021668585.title: Colonia Agrippina (Present-Day Cologne) Accurately Described in the Year 1571
2021668585.note: Already English, but flagged only because it was never translated; nothing to translate. Colonia Agrippina is the Roman and Latin name of Cologne and is kept as a name. Only the trailing full stop is dropped.

2021668721.title: Nautical Planisphere
2021668721.note: Already English; the flag was only that nothing was translated. Trailing catalogue full stop dropped. This is the Caverio chart of c. 1506, so the title stays as the archive gives it.

73695756.was: Carte des pays connus sous le nom de Canada, dans laquelle sont distinguées les possessions françoises, & angl?
73695756.title: Map of the countries known by the name of Canada, in which the French and English possessions are distinguished
73695756.note: French, truncated by the archive at 'angl?' (the title is cut off, almost certainly for 'angloises'). The old translation copied the truncation into 'English?', which reads as a doubtful query. 'Canada' is a name and stays. The final word is completed as 'English' because the cut-off stem is plainly 'angl-' next to 'françoises'.

rijks:NG-1172.was: Plan van de slag bij Waterloo, 1815
rijks:NG-1172.title: Plan of the Battle of Waterloo, 1815
rijks:NG-1172.note: Dutch, never translated. Waterloo is a place name.

rijks:RP-P-1878-A-729X.title: Plan of the town of Goes
rijks:RP-P-1878-A-729X.note: Dutch 'Plattegrond' is a ground plan or town plan. Goes is a town in Zeeland, a name and not the English verb.

rijks:RP-P-1892-A-17232.title: Map of Middlesex
rijks:RP-P-1892-A-17232.note: Dutch, never translated. Middlesex is the English county, a name.

rijks:RP-P-1905-6760.was: Plan van het beleg van Tournai, 1709
rijks:RP-P-1905-6760.title: Plan of the siege of Tournai, 1709
rijks:RP-P-1905-6760.note: Dutch, never translated. Tournai is the Belgian city (Doornik in Dutch) and kept as in the archive's own title.

rijks:RP-P-1937-190.title: Plan of the town of Goes
rijks:RP-P-1937-190.note: Dutch 'Plattegrond' is a ground plan or town plan. Goes is a town in Zeeland, a name and not the English verb.

rijks:RP-P-AO-20-23.title: Plan of Amsterdam, 1612
rijks:RP-P-AO-20-23.note: Dutch, never translated. Plattegrond is a ground plan.

rijks:RP-P-AO-20-26-2.title: Plan of Amsterdam, 1612
rijks:RP-P-AO-20-26-2.note: Dutch, never translated. Plattegrond is a ground plan.

rijks:RP-P-OB-50.147.was: Kaart van de noordkust van Engeland bij Newcastle upon Tyne
rijks:RP-P-OB-50.147.title: Map of the north coast of England near Newcastle upon Tyne
rijks:RP-P-OB-50.147.note: Dutch, never translated. Newcastle upon Tyne is already English and kept as a name.

rijks:RP-P-OB-77.245.was: Kaart met de posities van de geallieerden en de Fransen bij het beleg van Namen, 1695
rijks:RP-P-OB-77.245.title: Map showing the positions of the Allies and the French at the siege of Namur, 1695
rijks:RP-P-OB-77.245.note: Dutch, never translated. Namen is the Dutch name of Namur.

rijks:RP-P-OB-77.255.was: Kaart met de posities van de geallieerden onder Willem III bij het beleg van Namen, 1695
rijks:RP-P-OB-77.255.title: Map showing the positions of the Allies under William III at the siege of Namur, 1695
rijks:RP-P-OB-77.255.note: Dutch, never translated. Namen is the Dutch name of Namur; Willem III is William III.

00552972.was: Atlas général de la Chine, de la Tartarie chinoise, et du Tibet : pour servir aux différentes descriptions et histoires de cet empire
00552972.title: General Atlas of China, Chinese Tartary, and Tibet: to serve for the various descriptions and histories of this empire
00552972.note: Never translated: the archive's French was published as is. Re-catalogued with a longer subtitle, so this is written against the current text. Tartarie chinoise is Chinese Tartary, the historical region, not a modern country.

2003623128.was: Les costes aux environs de la rivière de Misisipi : découvertes par Mr. de la Salle en 1683 et reconnues par Mr. le Chevallier d'Iberville en 1698 et 1699
2003623128.title: The coasts around the Misisipi River: discovered by Mr. de La Salle in 1683 and explored by the Chevalier d'Iberville in 1698 and 1699
2003623128.note: Three faults. 'Costes' (old French for côtes, coasts) was left untranslated; 'reconnues' means explored or surveyed, not 'recognized'; and the caption was cut off at 'Iberville…', dropping the dates 1698 and 1699. The map's own spelling Misisipi is kept as a name.

2003623374.was: [Mapa del Golfo y costa de la Nueva España : desde el Río de Panuco hasta el cabo de Santa Elena ...]
2003623374.title: [Map of the Gulf and coast of New Spain: from the Río de Panuco to Cape Santa Elena ...]
2003623374.note: 'Cabo de Santa Elena' is a cape on the coast, named for St. Helen(a) as a place name; the translator rendered it 'Cape of St. Helena', which reads as the South Atlantic island. Cape Santa Elena and Río de Panuco are names and stay as the archive has them. Square brackets kept: the title is supplied by the cataloguer.

2003623398.was: De Eylanden en Vastelanden van Westindien
2003623398.title: The Islands and Mainlands of the West Indies
2003623398.note: Never translated: Dutch was published as is. 'Eylanden' is islands and 'Vastelanden' is mainlands (as opposed to islands), not 'continents'.

2003623407.was: Caert vande Svydt Rivier in Niew Nederland
2003623407.title: Chart of the South River in New Netherland
2003623407.note: Two faults. 'Caert' (chart) was left untranslated and 'Svydt' (zuid, south) was half-copied as 'River' with the wrong word order left over; and the colony is New Netherland, singular, not 'Niew Netherlands'. The South River is the Delaware.

2004629174.was: La herdike enterprinse faict par le Signeur Draeck D'Avoir cirquit toute la Terre
2004629174.title: The heroic enterprise carried out by Sir Drake, of having circled the whole Earth
2004629174.note: Never translated: 16th-century French was published as is. 'herdike' is a misspelling of héroïque, 'Signeur' of seigneur (lord, here Sir), 'faict' is made/carried out, and 'cirquit' is circuit: to have gone all the way round the Earth. Drake is a person's name and stays.

2006627675.was: Croquis de l'Afrique Équatoriale : contenant les dernier renseignements recueillis par les agents de l'Association Internationale du Congo
2006627675.title: Sketch of Equatorial Africa: containing the latest information gathered by the agents of the International Association of the Congo
2006627675.note: Two faults. 'Croquis' is a single sketch, not 'Sketches'; and the caption was cut off at 'International Association of…', losing 'the Congo', which is the name of the body.

2013593001.was: Etats du Grand-Seigneur en Asie : Empire de Perse, Pays des Usbecs, Arabie et Egypte
2013593001.title: Dominions of the Grand Signior in Asia: Empire of Persia, Land of the Uzbeks, Arabia and Egypt
2013593001.note: 'Grand-Seigneur' was rendered 'Great Lord'. It is the standard European title for the Ottoman Sultan (Grand Signior), so it is a title, not a description. 'Usbecs' is the Uzbeks and 'Pays' is land, not 'Countries'.

2021668534.was: China, with Korea and Parts of Tartarstan: the Closest Parts, from the Maps Drawn by Jesuit Missionaries in the Years 1708 to 1717.
2021668534.title: China, with Korea and Parts of Tartary: the Closest Parts, from the Maps Drawn by Jesuit Missionaries in the Years 1708 to 1717.
2021668534.note: Already English but wrong: 'Tartarstan' is not a place. The region is Tartary, the old European name for inner and northern Asia; '-stan' was modernised on by mistake, which also reads as Tatarstan. Rest of the caption left as the archive has it.

2021668715.was: Nautical Atlas of the World, Folio 6 Recto, North Atlantic Ocean.
2021668715.title: Nautical Atlas of the World, Folio 6 Recto: North Atlantic Ocean.
2021668715.note: Already English, so nothing was mistranslated; the only fault was the comma splicing the folio number to the subject, which reads as a list of three things. Wording otherwise unchanged; no detail added.

2024597441.title: Sable Island
2024597441.note: Sable here is the name, not the French word for sand. The cartographic record places it at Sable Island, Nova Scotia; 'Isle of Sand' translated a name as vocabulary.

89690209.was: Karte derer englischen Unternehmungen zur See auf denen französischen Küsten desgleichen in denen französischen Colonien in Africa und dem mitternæchtlichen America : aus denen beste Relationen u. bosondern Nachrichten gezogen ... u. mit historischen Anmerckunge erläutert
89690209.title: Map of the English naval enterprises against the French coasts, likewise in the French colonies in Africa and North America: drawn from the best reports and special accounts ... and explained with historical notes
89690209.note: Three faults. The caption was cut off after 'French coasts', losing the colonies in Africa and North America; 'derer englischen Unternehmungen' is 'of the English enterprises', which was garbled into 'of their English enterprises'; and 'mitternæchtlichen' is an old spelling of nördlich, northern. Typos in the archive's German (bosondern, Anmerckunge) are read as besondern and Anmerckungen.

99446210.was: L'hydrographie françoise : recueil des cartes générales et particulières qui ont éte faites pour le service des vaisseaux du roy, par ordre des Ministres de la marine, depuis 1737, jusqu'en 1765
99446210.title: The French Hydrography: collection of general and particular charts made for the service of the King's ships, by order of the Ministers of the Navy, from 1737 to 1765
99446210.note: Two faults. The caption was cut off at 'Royal', losing 'by order of the Ministers of the Navy' and the dates; and 'cartes' in a nautical collection are charts, not maps. 'Vaisseaux du roy' is the King's ships.

rijks:NG-501-33.was: Zeekaart van de Golf van Biskaje
rijks:NG-501-33.title: Sea chart of the Bay of Biscay
rijks:NG-501-33.note: Never translated: Dutch was published as is. 'Zeekaart' is sea chart; 'Golf van Biskaje' is the Bay of Biscay, an old Dutch spelling of a place name.

rijks:NG-501-52.was: Zeekaart van het oostelijk deel van de Middellandse zee
rijks:NG-501-52.title: Sea chart of the eastern part of the Mediterranean
rijks:NG-501-52.note: Never translated: Dutch was published as is. 'Middellandse zee' is the Mediterranean Sea.

rijks:NG-NM-10388-50-A.was: Aanvang van het beleg van de Citadel van Antwerpen door het Fransche leger in December 1832
rijks:NG-NM-10388-50-A.title: Start of the siege of the Citadel of Antwerp by the French army in December 1832
rijks:NG-NM-10388-50-A.note: Never translated: Dutch was published as is. 'Aanvang' is start; Antwerpen is Antwerp.

rijks:RP-P-1896-A-19368-939.title: Plan of Amsterdam with a view of the city, 1300
rijks:RP-P-1896-A-19368-939.note: Never translated: Dutch was published as is. 'Plattegrond' is a ground plan of a town, 'stadsgezicht' a view of the city.

rijks:RP-P-1908-2394.title: Plan of the city of Ghent, 1838
rijks:RP-P-1908-2394.note: Never translated: Dutch was published as is. 'Gent' is Ghent, the Belgian city, and stays a name.

rijks:RP-P-AO-16-110.title: Siege of Breda, 1624-1625
rijks:RP-P-AO-16-110.note: Never translated: Dutch was published as is. 'Beleg' is siege; Breda is the Dutch city.

rijks:RP-P-AO-2-17.title: Map of Friesland and Groningen
rijks:RP-P-AO-2-17.note: Never translated: Dutch was published as is. Both are Dutch provinces, kept as names.

rijks:RP-P-AO-20-6.title: Plan of Amsterdam, 1400
rijks:RP-P-AO-20-6.note: Never translated: Dutch was published as is. 'Plattegrond' is a ground plan.

rijks:RP-P-AO-20-79-1.title: Plan of the fortifications of Amsterdam
rijks:RP-P-AO-20-79-1.note: Never translated: Dutch was published as is. 'Vestingplattegrond' is a plan of a fortified town: vesting is fortress or fortifications.

rijks:RP-P-AO-20-7A.title: Plan of Amsterdam, 1400
rijks:RP-P-AO-20-7A.note: Never translated: Dutch was published as is. 'Plattegrond' is a ground plan.

rijks:RP-P-OB-77.014A.was: Kaart van het beleg van Diksmuide (bovenblad), 1647
rijks:RP-P-OB-77.014A.title: Map of the siege of Diksmuide (upper sheet), 1647
rijks:RP-P-OB-77.014A.note: Never translated: Dutch was published as is. 'Beleg' is siege, 'bovenblad' the upper sheet of a two-sheet print; Diksmuide is the Flemish town.

2003623129.title: Florida
2003623129.note: Never translated: the archive's French title 'La Floride' was published as-is. It is simply 'Florida' (Sanson's map of the coast from Secotan in Virginia to Planuco in Mexico).

2004629170.was: Nova et exacta delineatio Americae partis avstralis. qve est : Brasilia, Caribana, Gviana regnũm noũũm, Castilia del Oro, Nicaragva, insũlae Antillas et Perv. Et sub Tropico Capricorni, Chile, Rio della Plata, Patagonṽ, & Fretṽ Magellanicv̄
2004629170.title: New and exact delineation of the southern part of America, which is: Brasilia, Caribana, Guiana, the New Kingdom, Castilia del Oro, Nicaragua, the islands of the Antilles, and Peru. And below the Tropic of Capricorn, Chile, Rio della Plata, Patagonia, and the Strait of Magellan
2004629170.note: Latin title (Hulsius, Nuremberg 1602), never translated. The catalogue transcribes the printer's abbreviation marks and u/v spellings (regnũm noũũm = regnum novum, 'Fretṽ Magellanicv̄' = Fretum Magellanicum); read through those. 'Avstralis' is australis, 'southern'. Place names kept as printed: Caribana, Castilia del Oro, Rio della Plata.

73694435.was: Plan de l'île d'Amelia à la côte de la Floride orientale, tiré de la carte de la Georgie et de la Caroline méridionale de De Brahm, et assujeti pour le port de l'entrée de la riviere de Nassau, rédigé d'après la carte du W. Fuller. Plan de la barre et du port d'Amelia, à la côte de la Floride orientale, levé en janvier 1775, par Jacob Blamey
73694435.title: Plan of the island of Amelia on the coast of East Florida, taken from De Brahm's map of Georgia and South Carolina, and adapted for the harbour at the entrance of the Nassau River, drawn up after the map of W. Fuller. Plan of the bar and harbour of Amelia, on the coast of East Florida, surveyed in January 1775 by Jacob Blamey
73694435.note: Published text stopped after 'De Brahm', dropping the rest of a two-part title: the Nassau River entrance, Fuller as the source map, and the second plan (bar and harbour of Amelia, surveyed January 1775 by Jacob Blamey). Also 'Plan' was rendered 'Map'; these are harbour plans. 'Assujeti' = adapted/fitted to. Names kept: Amelia, De Brahm, Nassau, W. Fuller, Jacob Blamey.

73694637.was: Carte geographiqve de la novvelle Franse
73694637.title: Geographical map of New France
73694637.note: Thoreau's manuscript spells it 'novvelle Franse': v for u (period lettering) and an unusual s for c. The translator treated it as an unknown word and published 'novelle Franse'. It is 'nouvelle France', New France; the proper name should be translated, not left half-French.

73696323.was: Plan du port de Chibouctou à la côte de l'Acadie avec les côtes voisines
73696323.title: Plan of the harbour of Chibouctou on the coast of Acadia, with the neighbouring coasts
73696323.note: 'Plan' is a harbour plan, not a 'map'; 'port' is harbour. Chibouctou (Chebucto) is the place name and is kept as written. The old text was close but loose ('at the coast', 'nearby'); this is the literal reading of the French.

74693105.was: Carte réduite des côtes orientales de l'Amérique septentrionale. Contenant celles des provinces de New-York et de la Nouvelle Angleterre, celles de l'Acadie ou Nouvelle Ecosse, de l'Île Royale de l'Île St. Jean, avec l'intérieur du pays
74693105.title: Reduced chart of the eastern coasts of North America. Containing those of the provinces of New York and New England, those of Acadia or Nova Scotia, of Île Royale and Île St. Jean, with the interior of the country
74693105.note: Published text stopped mid-title after 'New England', dropping Acadia/Nova Scotia, Île Royale, Île St. Jean and the interior. 'Carte réduite' is a nautical chart on a reduced (Mercator) scale, so 'chart' rather than 'map'. Island names kept as printed.

74696151.was: Archipelague du Mexique ou sont les isles de Cuba, Espagnole, Ìamaïque, &c
74696151.title: Archipelago of Mexico, in which are the islands of Cuba, Hispaniola, Jamaica, &c
74696151.note: 'Espagnole' is Hispaniola (the 'Spanish island'), a place name, but was rendered as the adjective 'Spanish'. 'Ìamaïque' (I for J, with a stray accent) is Jamaica, but was published as 'American'. Also 'ou sont' = 'in which are', not 'or are'; 'ou' here is 'where', not 'or'.

98688431.was: From the Humboldt Mountains to the Mud Lakes
98688431.title: From the Humboldt Mountains to the Mud Lakes
98688431.note: False alarm: the archive's title is already English and correct (Egloffstein, Pacific Railroad Survey map no. 3). It was flagged only because no language was detected. Kept as is.

rijks:RP-P-1909-374.title: Siege of Maastricht, 1632
rijks:RP-P-1909-374.note: Dutch, never translated. 'Belegering' = siege. Maastricht is a place name and stays.

2004627237.was: Carta de la Provincia de Quito y de sus adjacentes
2004627237.title: Map of the Province of Quito and its adjacent areas
2004627237.note: Spanish (Maldonado, 1750). 'Carta' here is a chart/map, not a letter, and 'adjacentes' is 'adjacent' (old spelling of 'adyacentes'), not 'deputies' -- the translator seems to have reached for 'adjuntos'. Quito stays a place name.

rijks:RP-P-1909-394.title: Siege of Bergen, 1709
rijks:RP-P-1909-394.note: Dutch, never translated. 'Belegering' = siege. Bergen is kept as the archive has it; note that in 1709 it is most likely Mons (Bergen in Dutch), not Bergen op Zoom, so do not 'expand' it to Bergen op Zoom.

rijks:RP-P-AO-16-122-1.was: Loopgraven van het Staatse leger bij de forten Isabella en Sint-Anthonie tijdens het beleg van Den Bosch, 1629
rijks:RP-P-AO-16-122-1.title: Trenches of the States Army at Forts Isabella and Sint-Anthonie during the Siege of Den Bosch, 1629
rijks:RP-P-AO-16-122-1.note: Dutch, never translated. 'Loopgraven' = trenches, 'Staatse leger' = army of the States (General), 'beleg' = siege. Isabella, Sint-Anthonie and Den Bosch are names and stay as they are.

2003627086.was: Carte du Missouri : levee ou rectifiée dans toute son etendue
2003627086.title: Map of the Missouri: surveyed or corrected throughout its whole extent
2003627086.note: French. 'levee' (levée) here is the surveying sense, 'surveyed/laid down', not 'raised'; 'rectifiée' is 'corrected', not 'rectified'. 'dans toute son etendue' is 'throughout its whole extent', not 'in all its end'. Missouri is the river, as the 'Carte du Missouri' of the period usually is.

2017585865.was: Carte de la mer du sud et des costes d'Amerque et d'Asie, situées sur cette mer ; Carte de la mer du nord et des costes d'Amerique, d'Europe et d'Afrique, situées sur cette mer
2017585865.title: Map of the South Sea and of the coasts of America and Asia situated on that sea; Map of the North Sea and of the coasts of America, Europe and Africa situated on that sea
2017585865.note: French. 'costes' is the old spelling of 'côtes' (coasts), not 'cost'. The translator dropped the whole second title after the semicolon (the North Sea chart). 'Mer du sud' and 'mer du nord' are the period names for the Pacific and the Atlantic and are kept literal. 'Amerque' is a typo in the archive for Amerique.

2021668626.was: Map of the City of Baracoa.
2021668626.title: Map of the City of Baracoa
2021668626.note: Already English in the archive, so never translated and nothing to translate. No fault found beyond the trailing full stop, which is dropped. Baracoa is a place name and stays as it is; no detail added.

73696301.was: Plan du bassin et de la riviere du Port Royal ou Annapolis, dans l'Acadie, sur la côte orientale de la baie Francoise
73696301.title: Plan of the basin and river of Port Royal, or Annapolis, in Acadia, on the eastern coast of the French Bay
73696301.note: French. 'baie Francoise' is the old name for the Bay of Fundy (baie Françoise), 'French Bay', not 'Francoise Bay' as if Francoise were a person. 'Port Royal ou Annapolis' is one place under two names, so 'of the Port Royal' was wrong too. Acadia, Port Royal and Annapolis are names and stay.

rijks:RP-P-1909-438.title: Siege of 's-Hertogenbosch, 1629
rijks:RP-P-1909-438.note: Dutch, never translated. 'Beleg' = siege. 's-Hertogenbosch (Den Bosch) is a place name and keeps its apostrophe-s form.

rijks:RP-P-AO-23-57.was: Plattegrond van de zitplaatsen in de Oosterkerk te Amsterdam
rijks:RP-P-AO-23-57.title: Plan of the seating in the Oosterkerk in Amsterdam
rijks:RP-P-AO-23-57.note: Dutch, never translated. 'Plattegrond' = floor plan, 'zitplaatsen' = seats/seating, 'te' = in/at. Oosterkerk is a church name and stays as it is.

rijks:RP-P-OB-50.148.was: Kaart van de Engelse kust tussen de Isle of Wight en Dover
rijks:RP-P-OB-50.148.title: Map of the English coast between the Isle of Wight and Dover
rijks:RP-P-OB-50.148.note: Dutch, never translated. 'Kaart' = map, 'Engelse kust' = English coast, 'tussen ... en' = between ... and. Isle of Wight and Dover are already English place names.

74694146.title: North America
74694146.note: French, never translated. 'L'Amérique septentrionale' is period French for North America ('septentrional' = northern). The pool still held the French original.

97683511.was: L'Amerique divisée en ses principales parties où sont distingués les uns des autres les estats : selon quils appartiennent presentement aux differents souverains de l'Europe : dressée sur les relations les plus recentes et rectifiées sur les dernieres observations
97683511.title: America divided into its principal parts, in which the states are distinguished from one another according to which sovereigns of Europe they presently belong to: drawn from the most recent accounts and corrected by the latest observations
97683511.note: French, never translated. 'divisée en ses principales parties' = divided into its principal parts; 'estats' = states (old spelling); 'selon qu'ils appartiennent présentement aux différents souverains de l'Europe' = according to which of Europe's various sovereigns they presently belong to; 'relations' = accounts/reports, not 'relationships'; 'rectifiées' = corrected.

rijks:RP-P-1909-444.title: Siege of Dunkirk, 1646
rijks:RP-P-1909-444.note: Dutch, never translated. 'Beleg' = siege; 'Duinkerken' is the Dutch name of Dunkirk (French Dunkerque), a place name, not vocabulary.

00560609.was: Plano ichnographico de la ciudad de Mexico que demuestra el reglamento general de sus calles asi para la comodidad y hermosura, como para la correccion y extirpacion de las maldades ge. hay en sus barrios, por la infinidad de sitios escondidos, callejones sin transito, ruinas y paderones que las ocasionan, a pesar del zelo de los justics. de orden del Exmo. Sr. Conde Revilla Gigedo por el Mtro. Mayor D. Ignacio Castera, año de 1794
00560609.title: Ichnographic plan of the city of Mexico, showing the general regulation of its streets, both for comfort and beauty and for the correction and eradication of the evils found in its districts, owing to the infinity of hidden places, dead-end alleys, ruins and paderones that cause them, despite the zeal of the justices. By order of the Most Excellent Lord Count of Revilla Gigedo, by Master Mayor Don Ignacio Castera, year 1794
00560609.note: Spanish (18th-c. spelling), never translated. 'Ichnographico' = ground-plan (ichnography), not a stray word; 'Mtro. Mayor' = Maestro Mayor, the city's chief architect; 'ge.' = que and 'justics.' = justicias are abbreviations; 'Revilla Gigedo' (viceroy) and 'Ignacio Castera' are names. 'paderones' is left as written (probably paredones, ruined walls, but the caption does not say). Written against the re-catalogued caption.

2003623130.title: Plan of New Orleans
2003623130.note: French, 'Plan de la Nouvelle Orleans'. The published words were right but in French word order ('New Orleans Plan'); a place name stays a name, so New Orleans is kept whole.

2004629013.was: Nouvelle carte physique, politique, industrielle & commericale de l'Amerique Centrale et des Antilles : avec un plan spécial des possessions de la Compagnie belge de colonisation dans l'Amerique Centrale, état de Guatemala
2004629013.title: New physical, political, industrial and commercial map of Central America and the Antilles: with a special plan of the possessions of the Belgian Colonisation Company in Central America, State of Guatemala
2004629013.note: French, published cut off at 'special plan of…', losing the Belgian colonisation company and Guatemala. 'commericale' is the archive's own typo for commerciale. Antilles kept as the proper regional name.

2004629230.title: Persia (Iran), Afghanistan and Baluchistan
2004629230.note: Already English; the pool read 'Persian (Iran)', an adjective for a place name, flagged as detected-language id. The archive's own words are 'Persia (Iran)'. Baluchistan is a region name, kept.

2005630142.was: Qubbec, ville de l'Amerique septentrionale dans la Nouvelle France avec titre d'Eveché située sur le fleuve de St. Laurens a 310 degrez 17 minutes de longitude et 46 degrez 55 minutes de latitude : elle fut Assiegée par les Anglois sur les Francois par qui elle est encore possédée l'an 1670 depuis le 16e octobre jusqu'au 22e du meme Mois : monsr de frontenac etant pour lors gouverneur du pays qui leur fit hontue sement lever le siege
2005630142.title: Québec, city of North America in New France with the title of bishopric, situated on the river St. Lawrence at 310 degrees 17 minutes longitude and 46 degrees 55 minutes latitude: it was besieged by the English, from the French, by whom it is still held, in the year 1670 from the 16th of October to the 22nd of the same month: Monsieur de Frontenac being at that time governor of the country, who shamefully made them raise the siege
2005630142.note: French (17th-c. spelling), never translated. The archive's 'Qubbec' is a dropped accent for Québec. 'St. Laurens' is the St. Lawrence; 'Eveché' = bishopric; 'hontuesement' = shamefully; 'lever le siege' = raise the siege. Frontenac is a person. The caption says 1670 and the translation keeps it. Written against the re-catalogued caption.

2006636637.was: Letts's bird's eye view of the approaches to India
2006636637.title: Letts's bird's eye view of the approaches to India
2006636637.note: Already English; no translation needed. Letts is the publisher's surname, a name not a word. Flagged only because language detection failed.

2013593031.was: Kriegskarte von Agypten, Palastina und Arabien
2013593031.title: War Map of Egypt, Palestine and Arabia
2013593031.note: German. 'Palastina' was left half-translated in the pool (a lost umlaut, Palästina) and should read Palestine; Agypten likewise (Ägypten) is Egypt.

2017590449.title: New map of Terra Mariae (Maryland)
2017590449.note: Latin, never translated. 'Terrae-Mariae' is Mary's Land, the colonial name of Maryland (Lord Baltimore's colony, per the dedication) and is kept as a name.

2017590615.title: New map of Virginia
2017590615.note: Latin, never translated. 'Nova Virginiae tabvla' = new map of Virginia; 'tabvla' uses v for u.

74695315.title: Canada, sheet II, XXXV, B 32
74695315.note: French, never translated. 'IIe. feuille' = 2nd sheet (feuille), not a title word; XXXV and B 32 are the sheet's own reference numbers and are kept.

77696392.was: Plan goroda Tomska s prilegai︠u︡shcheĭ k nemu zheli︠e︡znodorozhnoĭ vi︠e︡tvʹi︠u︡
77696392.title: Plan of the city of Tomsk with its adjoining railway branch
77696392.note: Russian in library transliteration, which the pool translator took for something else: 'Plan of Gorida Tomska with its fits'. 'goroda' = of the city, Tomska = Tomsk (a place), 'prilegai︠u︡shcheĭ k nemu' = adjoining it, 'zheli︠e︡znodorozhnoĭ vi︠e︡tvʹi︠u︡' = railway branch.

80691936.title: Map of Yamashiro Province
80691936.note: Japanese (romanised), never translated. 'Kuni' = province, 'ezu' = pictorial map; Yamashiro is the province's name (around Kyoto) and stays a name.

88691705.title: [Map of Japan (Nihon-zu sara)]
88691705.note: Japanese (romanised), never translated. 'Nihon-zu' = map of Japan. 'sara' is left as written: the caption does not say what it means and it is not guessed at. Brackets are the cataloguer's. Written against the re-catalogued caption.

88694864.was: Seisen Dai Nihon zenzu, ichimei, Dōchū hitori annai : tsuketari, meishōga iri
88694864.title: Newly selected complete map of Great Japan, also called a Solo Traveller's Guide to the Highways: with pictures of famous places added
88694864.note: Japanese (romanised), never translated. 'Seisen' = carefully selected/revised, 'Dai Nihon zenzu' = complete map of Great Japan, 'ichimei' = also called, 'Dōchū hitori annai' = a lone traveller's guide to the road, 'tsuketari' = with added, 'meishōga iri' = containing pictures of famous places.

gm72003581.was: A draught of the Bay of Honduras and part of the Musquetto Shore
gm72003581.title: A draught of the Bay of Honduras and part of the Musquetto Shore
gm72003581.note: Already English; 'draught' is the period word for chart or plan and 'Musquetto Shore' the 18th-c. spelling of the Mosquito Coast. Kept in the archive's own words; flagged only because language detection failed.

rijks:NG-501-30.was: Kaart van de kust van Spanje en Portugal
rijks:NG-501-30.title: Map of the coast of Spain and Portugal

rijks:RP-P-1896-A-19368-221.was: Plattegrond van de stad Groningen tijdens het beleg van 1594
rijks:RP-P-1896-A-19368-221.title: Plan of the city of Groningen during the siege of 1594
rijks:RP-P-1896-A-19368-221.note: Dutch, never translated. 'Plattegrond' = ground plan; 'beleg' = siege; Groningen is a city name.

rijks:RP-P-1905-277.title: Battle of Fleurus, 1690
rijks:RP-P-1905-277.note: Dutch, never translated. 'Slag bij' = battle of; Fleurus is a place name.

rijks:RP-P-1909-378.title: Siege of Armentières, 1647
rijks:RP-P-1909-378.note: Dutch, never translated. 'Belegering' = siege; Armentières is a place name.

rijks:RP-P-1909-393.title: Siege of Mons (Bergen), 1709
rijks:RP-P-1909-393.note: Dutch, never translated. 'Bergen' here is the Dutch name of Mons in Hainaut (siege of 1709), not Bergen in Norway or Bergen op Zoom; both names given so neither is lost.

rijks:RP-P-1909-441.title: Siege of Breda, 1637
rijks:RP-P-1909-441.note: Dutch, never translated. Breda is a place name.

rijks:RP-P-1910-2233.was: Mislukt beleg van Brussel door de Fransen, 1708
rijks:RP-P-1910-2233.title: Failed siege of Brussels by the French, 1708
rijks:RP-P-1910-2233.note: Dutch, never translated. 'Mislukt beleg' = failed siege; 'Brussel' is Brussels, 'de Fransen' the French.

rijks:RP-P-AO-16-111.was: Kaart van de baronie van Breda met het beleg van 1624-1625
rijks:RP-P-AO-16-111.title: Map of the barony of Breda with the siege of 1624-1625
rijks:RP-P-AO-16-111.note: Dutch, never translated. 'Baronie' = barony; Breda is a place name.

rijks:RP-P-OB-50.149.was: Kaart van de kust van Noorwegen en Zweden tussen Merdøy en Uddevalla
rijks:RP-P-OB-50.149.title: Map of the coast of Norway and Sweden between Merdøy and Uddevalla
rijks:RP-P-OB-50.149.note: Dutch, never translated. Merdøy (Norwegian island) and Uddevalla (Swedish town) are place names; the ø is kept.

rijks:RP-P-OB-50.150.was: Kaart een deel van de kust van Noorwegen en Zweden
rijks:RP-P-OB-50.150.title: Map of part of the coast of Norway and Sweden
rijks:RP-P-OB-50.150.note: Dutch, never translated. 'Kaart een deel van' (sic, a missing 'van') = map of part of.

rijks:RP-P-OB-77.250.was: Kaart van de versterkingen van Namen bij het beleg in 1695
rijks:RP-P-OB-77.250.title: Map of the fortifications of Namur during the siege of 1695
rijks:RP-P-OB-77.250.note: Dutch, never translated. 'Namen' is the Dutch name of Namur (Belgium), a place; the siege is that of 1695.

rijks:RP-P-OB-77.251.was: Kaart van de versterkingen van Namen bij het beleg in 1695
rijks:RP-P-OB-77.251.title: Map of the fortifications of Namur during the siege of 1695
rijks:RP-P-OB-77.251.note: Dutch, never translated. 'Namen' is the Dutch name of Namur (Belgium), a place; same caption as RP-P-OB-77.250.

2021668499.title: Sketch Map of British Guiana.
2021668499.note: Already English; flagged only because language detection returned unknown. Wording is correct and British Guiana (present-day Guyana) is a place name kept as is. Caption left unchanged on purpose; no fault to fix.

99447785.was: Gipsometricheskai︠a︡ karta Rossīĭskoĭ Imperīi : (opyt izobrazhenīi︠a︡ relʹefa Imperīi)
99447785.title: Hypsometric map of the Russian Empire: (an attempt at depicting the relief of the Empire)
99447785.note: Russian, Library of Congress-style romanization (Gipsometricheskaia karta Rossiiskoi Imperii), never translated. Gipsometricheskaia is 'hypsometric' (elevation shown by tints), not a name; Rossiiskaia Imperiia is the Russian Empire. Opyt izobrazheniia rel'efa = 'an attempt at depicting the relief'.

rijks:RP-P-1881-A-4850.was: Kaart van beleg en verovering van Sas-van-Gent, 1644
rijks:RP-P-1881-A-4850.title: Map of the siege and capture of Sas van Gent, 1644
rijks:RP-P-1881-A-4850.note: Dutch, never translated. Sas-van-Gent (Sas van Gent) is a town in Zeeland, a place name kept as is; beleg en verovering = siege and capture.

rijks:RP-P-1891-A-16621.was: Wereldkaart met een allegorie op de vier elementen
rijks:RP-P-1891-A-16621.title: World map with an allegory of the four elements
rijks:RP-P-1891-A-16621.note: Dutch, never translated. No proper names; Wereldkaart = world map, vier elementen = four elements.

rijks:RP-P-1909-443.title: Siege of Hulst, 1645
rijks:RP-P-1909-443.note: Dutch, never translated. Hulst is a town in Zeeland Flanders, a place name kept as is, not vocabulary; Beleg = siege.

rijks:RP-P-1910-2197.was: Kaart van het fort Schenckenschans, veroverd door de Fransen in 1672
rijks:RP-P-1910-2197.title: Map of the fort of Schenckenschans, captured by the French in 1672
rijks:RP-P-1910-2197.note: Dutch, never translated. Schenckenschans (Schenkenschans) is a fortress on the Rhine near Kleve, a place name kept in its period spelling; veroverd door de Fransen = captured by the French.
